name: Ultra Despair Pussies
source:
You play as Makoto, one of 13 freshmen trapped inside Hope's Peak Academy. Instead of murder, the game is all about sexual conquest, seduction, and maybe even a "Climax Execution."

Monokuma, the psychotic perverted bear, shows up and cheerfully announces the new rules:
“Each of you will get a 'target'. Your goal is simple: convince them to have sex with you! Sexually dominate the other students! Break them, fuck them, make them your bitch!”

No killing, no blood, just pure chaos and horniness.

[From [url=https://ecchioverdose.itch.io/danganronpa-despair-pussies]itch.io[/url]]
